Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
There's the #vtes IRC chan that can be accessed on  this page . I suggest players looking for JoLmates pick a nickname starting / ending with jol_.

Example: jol_Ankha

Use
/nick fooo
to change your nick to fooo.
Maybe removing the "jol_" from your nick will help other people find JoL available players
